title: Integrative Analysis of Gene and Protein Expression Data Reveals Novel Clusters for Ovarian Cancer Prognosis.
snippet: Ovarian cancer exhibits clinical heterogeneity; reliable prognostic stratification remains challenging despite extensive biomarker research. We performed an integrative analysis of transcriptomic and proteomic data to identify prognostically distinct molecular clusters in ovarian cancer.
